classification: EXPLORATORY v1; materially confounded; numerical reproduction only
source: frozen v1-snapshot from the original harness-cost benchmark; never live logs

projection.requests: Explicit top-level allowlist in publication.py; usage retains only integer token counts, cache TTL subtotals, usage.cost. Drop identities, errors, thinking/output configuration, stop-reason, BYOK and cost_details. No request bodies were read/copied. Preserve row order.
projection.runs: All 186 scored metadata rows, no duplicate IDs/cells. No paths/prompts/identities.
projection.tasks: Only id, _domain, _tier from 24 task specs; no instructions, URLs, fixture paths or evaluator state.
projection.historical_outputs: Four numeric JSON references, checked for personal paths/PII/secret indicators; original figures and promotional REPORT excluded.
projection.review: Attributed historical review with path/command sanitization and declared count correction. Scripts adapted for public rate function/output locations; external private fixtures explicitly required for rescoring.
projection.public_loadout: Selected audited public schema/instruction/fetch/capture/replay files; portable refusal-to-overwrite home renderer; no private basehome scripts or caches.

derivations: regenerate.py and CORRECTIONS.md; no model/API/harness calls used for reproduction

upstream_universe_correction.authority: coordinated pinned OSWorld task manifest audit (not the erroneous 369/102 historical prose)

privacy_status: Curated field projection plus publication.py bounded text-pattern/filename scan; public schema placeholders and upstream license attribution are intentionally public, not secret values

publication_hardening.invocation_metadata: LaunchDarkly offline dummy is generated in memory only; command metadata stores an explicit non-credential marker. The generated invocation equals the previously accepted offline invocation. No real keys or recapture used.
publication_hardening.invariance: All 493 tools across nine servers, per-server schema bytes/hashes, package pins, source URLs and licenses unchanged from local integration commit; only one command metadata element changed.
publication_hardening.csv: Explicit LF in DictWriter; no CRLF normalization after export.
publication_hardening.privacy: Credential-shaped dummy literals are rejected by shape-based scanning, including all-zero placeholders. No dummy exemption or push-protection bypass.
